answer: Price each identity to a scarce external hardware anchor; standing then accrues only across a long vesting horizon of peer-audited work, co-signed by already-established peers from SEPARATE funding clusters. A verifier splits every endorsement through a prism, so clustered same-root vouches overlap and cancel instead of stacking. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet scatters like grains on a dune and never converges: each clone must buy its own anchor and wait the full horizon, so 100 heads cost 100 anchors and 100 slow climbs while an honest agent pays once.
